<p><b>Planks</b> are common <a href="/w/Block" title="Block">blocks</a> used as building blocks and in <a href="/w/Crafting" title="Crafting">crafting</a> recipes. They are usually one of the first things that a <a href="/w/Player" title="Player">player</a> crafts in <a href="/w/Survival" title="Survival">Survival</a> mode. There are currently 12​<sup class="nowrap Inline-Template" title="">[<i><span title="This statement does not apply to upcoming versions of Minecraft">until:</span> <a href="/w/Wilderness_Bound" title="Wilderness Bound">Wilderness Bound</a></i>]</sup>/13​<sup class="nowrap Inline-Template" title="">[<i><span title="This statement applies only to upcoming versions of Minecraft.">upcoming:</span> <a href="/w/Wilderness_Bound" title="Wilderness Bound">Wilderness Bound</a></i>]</sup> variants of planks, which can be differentiated into three categories: <b>Overworld planks</b> made from <a href="/w/Tree" title="Tree">tree</a> logs, <b>bamboo planks</b> made from <a href="/w/Blocks_of_bamboo" class="mw-redirect" title="Blocks of bamboo">blocks of bamboo</a>, and nonflammable <b>Nether planks</b> made from <a href="/w/Huge_fungus" class="mw-redirect mw-disambig" title="Huge fungus">huge fungus</a> stems.
</p>

<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Natural_generation">Natural generation</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Planks?section=4&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Natural generation" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Planks?action=edit&section=4" title="Edit section's source code: Natural generation"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p><span class="nowrap"><span class="sprite-file" style=""><span class="pixel-image" typeof="mw:File"><span><img alt="BlockSprite oak-planks.png: Sprite image for oak-planks in Minecraft" src="/images/BlockSprite_oak-planks.png?4f022" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="16" height="16" class="mw-file-element" data-file-width="16" data-file-height="16"></span></span></span><span class="sprite-text">Oak planks</span></span> generate as part of:
</p>
<ul><li><a href="/w/Mineshaft" title="Mineshaft">Mineshafts</a>, where they are used as beams supported by oak <a href="/w/Fence" title="Fence">fences</a> and as a platform where <a href="/w/Air" title="Air">air</a> is beneath.</li>
<li><a href="/w/Plains" title="Plains">Plains</a> <a href="/w/Village" title="Village">villages</a>, where they are used for various structures including walls, roofs, and floors of many buildings, as well as paths over <a href="/w/Water" title="Water">water</a>.</li>
<li><a href="/w/Stronghold" title="Stronghold">Strongholds</a>, where they are used for floors and pillars in the library and storage rooms.</li>
<li><a href="/w/Woodland_mansion" class="mw-redirect" title="Woodland mansion">Woodland mansions</a></li>
<li><a href="/w/Shipwreck" title="Shipwreck">Shipwrecks</a></li></ul>
<p><span class="nowrap"><span class="sprite-file" style=""><span class="pixel-image" typeof="mw:File"><span><img alt="BlockSprite spruce-planks.png: Sprite image for spruce-planks in Minecraft" src="/images/BlockSprite_spruce-planks.png?6696d" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="16" height="16" class="mw-file-element" data-file-width="16" data-file-height="16"></span></span></span><span class="sprite-text">Spruce planks</span></span> generate as part of: 
</p>
<ul><li><a href="/w/Swamp_hut" class="mw-redirect" title="Swamp hut">Swamp huts</a>, where they are used as a primary building material.</li>
<li><a href="/w/Taiga" title="Taiga">Taiga</a> and <a href="/w/Snowy_tundra" class="mw-redirect" title="Snowy tundra">snowy</a> <a href="/w/Village" title="Village">villages</a>, as a part of several buildings, with additional <a href="/w/Snowy_taiga" class="mw-redirect" title="Snowy taiga">snowy taiga</a> villages in <a href="/w/Bedrock_Edition" title="Bedrock Edition"><i>Bedrock Edition</i></a>.</li>
<li><a href="/w/Cold_Ocean_Ruins" title="Cold Ocean Ruins">Cold Ocean Ruins</a></li>
<li><a href="/w/Shipwreck" title="Shipwreck">Shipwrecks</a></li></ul>
<p><span class="nowrap"><span class="sprite-file" style=""><span class="pixel-image" typeof="mw:File"><span><img alt="BlockSprite birch-planks.png: Sprite image for birch-planks in Minecraft" src="/images/BlockSprite_birch-planks.png?61d14" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="16" height="16" class="mw-file-element" data-file-width="16" data-file-height="16"></span></span></span><span class="sprite-text">Birch planks</span></span> generate as part of: 
</p>
<ul><li><a href="/w/Woodland_mansion" class="mw-redirect" title="Woodland mansion">Woodland mansions</a></li>
<li><a href="/w/Shipwreck" title="Shipwreck">Shipwrecks</a></li>
<li><a href="/w/Pillager_outpost" class="mw-redirect" title="Pillager outpost">Pillager outposts</a></li></ul>
<p><span class="nowrap"><span class="sprite-file" style=""><span class="pixel-image" typeof="mw:File"><span><img alt="BlockSprite jungle-planks.png: Sprite image for jungle-planks in Minecraft" src="/images/BlockSprite_jungle-planks.png?374f3" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="16" height="16" class="mw-file-element" data-file-width="16" data-file-height="16"></span></span></span><span class="sprite-text">Jungle planks</span></span> generate as part of <a href="/w/Shipwreck" title="Shipwreck">shipwrecks</a>.
</p><p><span class="nowrap"><span class="sprite-file" style=""><span class="pixel-image" typeof="mw:File"><span><img alt="BlockSprite acacia-planks.png: Sprite image for acacia-planks in Minecraft" src="/images/BlockSprite_acacia-planks.png?30534" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="16" height="16" class="mw-file-element" data-file-width="16" data-file-height="16"></span></span></span><span class="sprite-text">Acacia planks</span></span> generate as part of: 
</p>
<ul><li><a href="/w/Savanna" title="Savanna">Savanna</a> villages</li>
<li><a href="/w/Shipwreck" title="Shipwreck">Shipwrecks</a>‌<sup class="nowrap Inline-Template" title="">[<i><span title="This statement only applies to Bedrock Edition"><a href="/w/Bedrock_Edition" title="Bedrock Edition">BE</a>  only</span></i>]</sup></li></ul>
<p><span class="nowrap"><span class="sprite-file" style=""><span class="pixel-image" typeof="mw:File"><span><img alt="BlockSprite dark-oak-planks.png: Sprite image for dark-oak-planks in Minecraft" src="/images/BlockSprite_dark-oak-planks.png?8e924" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="16" height="16" class="mw-file-element" data-file-width="16" data-file-height="16"></span></span></span><span class="sprite-text">Dark oak planks</span></span> generate as part of: 
</p>
<ul><li><a href="/w/Mineshaft" title="Mineshaft">Mineshafts</a> generated in <a href="/w/Badlands" title="Badlands">badlands</a> biomes</li>
<li><a href="/w/Woodland_mansion" class="mw-redirect" title="Woodland mansion">Woodland mansions</a></li>
<li><a href="/w/Cold_Ocean_Ruins" title="Cold Ocean Ruins">Cold Ocean Ruins</a></li>
<li><a href="/w/Shipwreck" title="Shipwreck">Shipwrecks</a></li>
<li><a href="/w/Pillager_outpost" class="mw-redirect" title="Pillager outpost">Pillager outposts</a></li>
<li><a href="/w/Ancient_cities" class="mw-redirect" title="Ancient cities">Ancient cities</a></li></ul>
<p>Mangrove, pale oak, crimson, warped, cherry and bamboo planks do not generate naturally.
</p>

<div class="mw-heading mw-heading2"><h2 id="Usage">Usage</h2><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Planks?section=6&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Usage" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Planks?action=edit&section=6" title="Edit section's source code: Usage"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p>Planks can be used to build structures, craft ingredients, or as <a href="/w/Fuel" class="mw-redirect" title="Fuel">fuel</a> for smelting. Crimson planks and warped planks, however, cannot be used as fuel.
</p>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Crafting_ingredient">Crafting ingredient</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Planks?section=7&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Crafting ingredient" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Planks?action=edit&section=7" title="Edit section's source code: Crafting ingredient"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p>Planks are used in many different crafting recipes. <a href="/w/Stairs" title="Stairs">Stairs</a>, <a href="/w/Slab" title="Slab">slabs</a>, <a href="/w/Fence" title="Fence">fences</a>, <a href="/w/Fence_gate" class="mw-redirect" title="Fence gate">fence gates</a>, <a href="/w/Door" title="Door">doors</a>, <a href="/w/Trapdoor" title="Trapdoor">trapdoors</a>, <a href="/w/Pressure_plate" class="mw-redirect" title="Pressure plate">pressure plates</a>, <a href="/w/Button" title="Button">buttons</a>, <a href="/w/Sign" title="Sign">signs</a>, and <a href="/w/Boat" title="Boat">boats</a> must be crafted from planks of the same type, and the crafted result depends on the type used. For other products, planks of different types can be mixed freely and the wood types in the product is indeterminate. Crimson and warped planks cannot be used to make boats.<sup id="cite_ref-2" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-2"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>1<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p>

<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Fuel">Fuel</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Planks?section=8&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Fuel" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Planks?action=edit&section=8" title="Edit section's source code: Fuel"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p><a href="/w/Overworld" title="Overworld">Overworld</a> planks can be used as a <a href="/w/Fuel" class="mw-redirect" title="Fuel">fuel</a> in <a href="/w/Furnace" title="Furnace">furnaces</a>, <a href="/w/Smelting" title="Smelting">smelting</a> 1.5 <a href="/w/Item" title="Item">items</a> per <a href="/w/Block" title="Block">block</a>.
</p><p><a href="/w/Nether" class="mw-redirect" title="Nether">Nether</a> planks (crimson and warped planks) cannot be used as <a href="/w/Fuel" class="mw-redirect" title="Fuel">fuel</a>, although they can be crafted into sticks or tools, which can be used as fuel.
</p>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Repairing">Repairing</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Planks?section=9&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Repairing" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Planks?action=edit&section=9" title="Edit section's source code: Repairing"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>

<div class="mw-heading mw-heading2"><h2 id="Trivia">Trivia</h2><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Planks?section=29&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Trivia" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Planks?action=edit&section=29" title="Edit section's source code: Trivia"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<ul><li>To craft each recipe once, a player would need 152 planks, including 10 for the recipes that require <a href="/w/Sticks" class="mw-redirect" title="Sticks">sticks</a>, and 6 for wooden <a href="/w/Slabs" class="mw-redirect" title="Slabs">slabs</a>. To craft all the other 10 wood variants of all recipes, the player would need an extra 384 planks, plus another 36 planks for the 72 sticks needed to make the <a href="/w/Fence" title="Fence">fence</a>, <a href="/w/Fence_gate" class="mw-redirect" title="Fence gate">fence gate</a>, and <a href="/w/Sign" title="Sign">sign</a> variants, adding up to a total of 572 planks.</li>
<li>Because the 13 variants of wooden planks can be used interchangeably in many recipes, there are 28561 ways of crafting a <a href="/w/Crafting_table" class="mw-redirect" title="Crafting table">crafting table</a>, 4.8 million ways of crafting a <a href="/w/Shield" title="Shield">shield</a>, 816 million ways of crafting a <a href="/w/Chest" title="Chest">chest</a>, <a href="/w/Jukebox" title="Jukebox">jukebox</a>, or <a href="/w/Note_block" class="mw-redirect" title="Note block">note block</a>, and 10.6 billion ways of crafting a <a href="/w/Chiseled_bookshelf" class="mw-redirect" title="Chiseled bookshelf">chiseled bookshelf</a>.</li></ul>
